entries.zh: 鬱熱；病人热郁如焚、为暑热所煎之症
entries.en: a sick person burning with heat; feverish oppression from sultry, pent-up heat

entries.zh: 病拖缺；久病拖延缠绵、愈而复发之疾（复发）
entries.en: a sick person with a relapse; an illness that drags on and breaks out again

entries.zh: 病沉痾（「阿」疑为「痾」）；沉痾痼疾、危重难愈之病
entries.en: a very dangerous illness; a grave, deep-seated chronic disease
entries.notes: 汉字带[疑:阿/痾]，取「沉痾」古义与西语 muy peligrosa 相证。

entries.zh: 辛苦重（「辛」疑为「幸」）；病势沉重、痛苦深重之疾
entries.en: a grave, dangerous illness; heavy suffering
entries.notes: 汉字带[疑:辛/幸]；取「辛苦（痛苦）＋重（沉重）」与 enfermedad graue, peligrosa 相证。

entries.zh: 呆症（「呆」疑为「杏」）；昏沉呆滞之症；西语谓危症，字义未合，释义存疑
entries.en: a dangerous illness (Spanish); Chinese gloss doubtful: a dazed, stupefied condition
entries.notes: 汉字带[疑:呆/杏]且与西语 peligrosa 语义不甚合，第三音节存疑，仅作保守两释。

entries.zh: 危急；病势危急之险症
entries.en: a dangerous illness; critical, perilous condition

entries.zh: 危險；病势危殆之险症
entries.en: a dangerous illness; perilous condition

entries.zh: 沉重；病势沉重、已至临危（行将不起）
entries.en: a sick person already at the last extremity; gravely ill, near death

entries.zh: 弊病；隐伏不显之疾、暗疾
entries.en: a hidden illness; latent, concealed disease

entries.zh: 瘴氣；瘴疠之气所致之疾、易相传染
entries.en: miasma, pestilential air; a contagious, epidemic disease

entries.zh: 惹病；招惹病气、染上疾病
entries.en: to catch an illness; infection picked up from another

entries.zh: 不快活；郁郁不乐、烦闷不适（不快活之症）
entries.en: indisposition of discontent; out of sorts, melancholy
entries.notes: L栏[残]（「q nomojoira, mi disgusa」不能确读），释义据汉字「不快活」及闽南、官话对音推定。

entries.zh: 破病；久病缠身、体弱多病之躯
entries.en: sickly by nature; chronically ill, broken down with sickness

entries.zh: 過勞；操劳过度、劳伤致病
entries.en: one made sick by overwork; illness from excessive labor
entries.notes: L栏[残]（「matlaymugong」不可确读），释义据汉字「過勞」及对音推定。

entries.zh: 染病；被传染而得病、病气沾染
entries.en: one who catches the disease from another; infected by contagion

entries.zh: 鮮嘗；字义与西语「易生不满者」不合，疑有讹字，释义存疑
entries.en: prone to discontent, a grumbler (Spanish); Chinese gloss doubtful and unresolvable
entries.notes: 汉字「鮮嘗」与西语 malcontentadizo 语义不合，对音层亦有缺损（原稿两字开头均记作 ch），语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 重滯；病沉重而滞塞、邪气壅滞之险症
entries.en: a dangerous case; heavy and stagnant condition, obstructed

entries.zh: 危篤；病危笃、命在旦夕
entries.en: critically ill; at death's door

entries.zh: 繫勞（「系」疑为「繫」）；相思成疾、繫念劳心之症
entries.en: lovesick; pining with longing (enfermo de amores)
entries.notes: 汉字带[疑:系/繫]；西语 enfermo de amores 即相思病，取「繫念劳心」为释。

entries.zh: 毋骨力（「不」疑为「毋」）；没有气力、病中无力
entries.en: sick without strength; strengthless, enfeebled
entries.notes: 汉字带[疑:不/毋]；闽南否定词「毋」(m̄) 与对音相合，义为无气力。

entries.zh: 風寒；伤风受寒、感冒风寒之疾
entries.en: a cold; illness from exposure to wind and chill

entries.zh: 感風个病；感风而得之病、伤风之疾（「个」为闽南语助词）
entries.en: an illness got from catching cold; a wind-cold one has taken
